text.card: A red giant 7,552 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.92 solar masses and 12.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,822 K at its surface.
